statement: The record shows invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291), so I will hold it to avoid a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the invoice was "already paid in full on 3 September (PAY-2291)," contradicting the unpaid status and identifying the specific problem of a duplicate payment.
